items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Well we wasn't making, but I'm going to tell you how that worked... We was playing for a chairman... each man had to go to Francois and throw back... But we held a job like that five years, see.

ctx.x: Well that was after Huey Swift? Yeah. And after Francois? Yeah.

Tiny Palm was after Francois? No, Tiny Palm was a little before Francois. See, I don't know if it, I don't know if it was Tiny Palm Band or Al when band, but they both was there together. See, you know, I think it was Tiny Palm, but Al when was doing a lot of managing, you know. But I'm pretty sure it was Tiny Palm Band, see.
Where at? At the Dreamland in Chicago. That's your first job on then?
